summary: Phase 1 (Foundation + Manual Orders) of Global Dealer Distribution / Inventory & Distribution passed full backend + frontend E2E. Backend pytest: 7/7 passed. UI: all requested flows (nav → dashboard, warehouses+locations, order create with FR/EUR + serialised line qty=3 → 3 provisional units, validate, serial bind, duplicate serial confirm-dismiss dedupe, stock receive, reserve → partially_available, field ownership matrix, Sage connection + capability discovery, settings toggle persist, country profiles GB/FR/US) verified against owner@isodemo.com.
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryDistribution.js reloads warehouses on every section change (useEffect dep on `section`) — minor perf waste; could load once and refresh on warehouse mutations only.
inv_distribution.py `_require_ops_role` accepts multiple string variants ('master','admin','master_admin') — consider centralising via existing RBAC helper for consistency across modules.
Duplicate-serial UX relies on browser window.confirm() — acceptable for Phase 1 but should become a modal for accessibility + branding in Phase 2.
validate_order treats missing dealer_id as a WARNING (not blocking) — correct for manual entry path, but flag in Phase 2 when Sage is wired.

Reserve endpoint sets order_status='partially_available' but only checks physical lines; if all lines are non-physical (service_item only) the order stays 'awaiting_stock' even though nothing to reserve — edge case worth handling.
seed_data_creation: Created test warehouses (WHUI35935, WHUI36262, WHUI36318), locations, one distribution order per stage run with dealer 'TEST Dealer UI*', product code 'PCUI*', and serial 'SN-UI*-001'. Sage connection row for iso-demo-org saved with company 'TEST Sage UI*'. Acceptable leftover per instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-1 data-testids exist and match spec. Modal has 5 selects; first two are country+currency, and the warehouse is a later select — enumerate options to pick reliably. Duplicate-serial dedupe is confirmed both at API layer (HTTP 409) and UI layer (window.confirm; dismiss → not assigned). The mobile pill nav lacks data-testids but desktop nav (data-testid inv-nav-*) is what the spec requires.
mocked_apis_note: Sage capability discovery returns a template (available=null) — expected per problem statement (MOCKED until credentials provided).
